name: ClearFeed
description:
The ClearFeed connector gives Claude access to customer support conversations and related context from ClearFeed.

Teams can use Claude to search and analyze support requests, understand the history of a customer issue, summarize conversations, identify recurring themes, and retrieve relevant information without switching between tools.

ClearFeed brings together customer interactions from channels such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and connected support systems, giving Claude a unified view of customer conversations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ClearFeed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ClearFeed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clearfeed.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ClearFeed MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClearFeed lists 25 MCP tools, including channels_delete, channels_update, collections_add_channels, collections_list, custom_fields_create, custom_fields_delete, custom_fields_list, custom_fields_update, customers_create, customers_get, customers_list, and customers_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ClearFeed?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ClearFeed in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, Conduit, DevRev, and Front.
ClearFeed requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ClearFeed is developed by ClearFeed, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
